results.title: 67 Old-School Memes To Remind You What The Internet Is For – Cats
results.description: When it comes to memes, nothing is more classic and iconic than cats. In fact, we can’t imagine social media without these graceful but derpy creatures. And we have the sneaking suspicion that the internet was invented specifically to give them more attention. Pandering to our feline overlords? Why, yes, we are! We’re featuring the very best, most relatable, and funniest cat memes from the aptly named ‘Cat Memes’ Facebook page. Check out the selection of our favorite pics. And remember, your family, friends, and colleagues can tell exactly how much you like them by how many memes you send them.
